meta.name: R.J. Decker
meta.description: El fotógrafo ex convicto RJ Decker trabaja como investigador privado en Florida del Sur, resolviendo casos extraños con su ex periodista, su esposa policía y una misteriosa mujer de su pasado.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Ex-con photographer R.J. Decker becomes a private investigator in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

videos.title: Twenty Pounds of Clem in a Ten-Pound Bag
videos.overview: Wish enlists R.J.'s help on a bizarre case when his late cellmate's son is wrongly accused of murder.

videos.title: The Needle and the Damage Done
videos.overview: R.J. is recruited by Emi to investigate the disappearance of a wealthy rehab tycoon's son; Mel and Catherine discover they have different views on parenting and finances.

videos.title: In Vanity Veritas
videos.overview: R.J. finds himself at the center of a suburban housewife murder mystery; Catherine worries that R.J. is getting too close to Emi.

videos.title: Burn Notice
videos.overview: R.J. unravels the truth about a Little League coach whose family is being mysteriously targeted; R.J.'s parole officer worries that he is pushing the boundaries of his conditional release.

videos.title: Brenner's Back
videos.overview: R.J. helps a young woman uncover the truth behind her boyfriend's sudden death; a dangerous figure from R.J.'s past resurfaces, bent on revenge.

videos.title: You've Got Bale
videos.overview: R.J. takes on a strange case following a grocery store robbery gone wrong; Emi's loyalty is tested when her father's misdeeds come to light.

videos.title: Burn the Boats
videos.overview: R.J. struggles with a difficult decision; Emi must contend with her family's secrets.

videos.title: Even Walls Fall Down
videos.overview: After R.J. learns the truth about what happened on the fateful day Lucas stole his camera, he enlists his inner circle to help him take down Victor Ochoa.

videos.title: The Point of Us Breaking
videos.overview: A reunion with an old prison acquaintance pulls R.J. into a string of daring bank heists as the fallout from Victor Ochoa's death deepens.

videos.title: Manos: Hands of Fate
videos.overview: A missing man, a mysterious item and a dangerous stranger in a pickup truck pull R.J. into one of his strangest cases yet; someone close to him is caught up in a mystery of their own.

videos.title: Arms and Armadillos
videos.overview: As Emi faces murder charges over her father's death, R.J. and Mel are convinced there's more to the story; a mysterious stranger with his own agenda offers to help -- for a price.

videos.title: The Angler
videos.overview: A murder at a fishing tournament reels R.J. into a case that becomes deeply personal when a figure from his past resurfaces.

videos.title: Better Luck Tomorrow
videos.overview: R.J. and his dad must discover who has been gaslighting the caretaker at a senior living community and unwind the murderous scheme that has R.J.'s client convinced he's living the same day in a loop.

videos.title: Blame It on the Rain
videos.overview: R.J. faces long odds and stormy tides when he investigates the violent death of a woman who appears to have died in a hurricane that never made landfall.

videos.title: Before You Accuse Me
videos.overview: Emi hires R.J. to re-investigate the murder of a police officer in hope of exonerating a possibly wrongly convicted man who took the fall; the sensitive investigation puts him at odds with Mel.
